faces.transcription:
This is a disrupt trial objective.

To set it up, separate the 13 Asia City cards from the Player deck, shuffle them, and place 4 of them faceup into the Operations area. These are the 4 trial cities.

Then, shuffle the remaining Asia cards back into the Player deck.

Finally, flip this card over and place it on top of the 4 trial City cards.

AUGUST OBJECTIVE 1

DISRUPT THE FOURTH TRIAL

Disrupt Trial in:
1, 2, 3 OR 4 KNOWN CITIES IN ASIA AT THE SAME TIME

Completed: Read Debrief 203
Failed: Read Debrief 100
